newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures close up in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures close up in quiet trade.

text.p: CME lumber futures closed higher in thin dealings, supported by expectations for increased lumber demand into the spring, traders said.

Expectations are that dealer and wholesaler interest for lumber will rise when the current winter weather pattern subsides. Interest rates are low and the pent up demand for housing will spark a rally in cash within the next few weeks, they said.
Cash sources noted a very quiet cash market currenty which kept futures trade light.
Lumber closed $3.60 per thousand board feet higher to $0.10 lower with March up most at $430.00 and May up $2.80 at $390.60 per tbf.
